fix: Public API panics on app-author input without a documented # Panics contract or a maybe_/try_ form. Return a typed error instead, e.g. `pub fn set_axis_directions(&mut self, horizontal: AxisDirection, vertical: AxisDirection) -> Result<(), AxisDirectionError>` with `if horizontal.axis() != Axis::Horizontal { return Err(AxisDirectionError::HorizontalNotHorizontal(horizontal)); }` and the same check for vertical, storing the fields only after both checks pass. Alternatively keep the panic, add a `# Panics` rustdoc section and provide `try_set_axis_directions` returning Result.
